findings.summary: Webhook events and API responses arrive on two different Stripe contract versions.
findings.note: Aurora Meter Pro parses the forwarded payload at the account default version and, in the same flow, reads objects back at the version it pins, then reconciles the two against each other. The harness's own unpinned reads answer at the account default and its pinned reads at the SDK default, which is why both appear above. Recorded separately, never normalised together. 04c owns the pin (P24).
